notes_for_editor: Very thin record. The Central US Lookouts page text we could read has only the name, county and agency. The FFLA list gives coordinates and 'Tower Gone'. The Forest Service page is about the Mountain tower and is cited only for forest context; it does not name South Fork and does not say South Fork was one of the 14 original towers. No built date, design, staffing, fires or site description found. Two WebSearch queries found nothing more. A map site lists a 'South Fork Fire Tower (historical)' in Price County, but it returned 403 and was not used. The Mountain tower paragraph is context only and should not be read as a statement about South Fork's access. Verification 2026-10-10: the story's Mountain sentence now says only that the Forest Service page does not mention South Fork; its visitor-climb clause was removed because it implies something about South Fork's access that no source states. The 'northern Wisconsin' descriptor was removed as unsourced.
